N00019-25-R-0018-0001 | 24 March 2026

Through this FOSR amendment, the Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) Patuxent River, MD hereby announces the cancellation of solicitation notice N00001925R0018 for the MH-60R/S PMI Maintenance and Squadron Support in Rota, Spain as of March 24, 2026. NAVAIR appreciates industry’s feedback on the draft and final FOSR announcements. As a direct result of this feedback and changes in hangar availability, the program is revisiting its requirements.  When applicable, revisions including instructions to provide feedback on future MH-60R/S PMI Maintenance and Squadron Support effort announcements will be posted under a new announcement via sam.gov. We appreciate your continued interest in Naval Aviation. THIS AMENDMENT IS NOT TO BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT, NOR WILL THE GOVERNMENT PAY FOR ANY INFORMATION SOLICITATED OR PROVIDED.

______________________________________________________________________________________________
